item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Lila studies the diagram of figures $R$ and $S$. Figure $S$ is the same shape and size as figure $R$, and $S$ is shown after a turn.

Which two claims correctly decide whether $R$ and $S$ are congruent?

options.A: $R$ and $S$ are congruent: same shape and size under exact superimposition, and turning is allowed.
options.B: $R$ and $S$ are congruent because they are both called figures on the page.
options.C: Exact fit under superimposition settles congruence, and a turn does not block that fit.
options.D: Congruence here requires a right angle, hypotenuse, and one matching side before the turn can be used.
